cells.B: Are there any errors (whiteouts, linethroughs, etc.)?
cells.H: Alterations on the face of the title are not accepted.

cells.B: Did the seller & co-seller sign the face of the title?
cells.D: Customer needs to go back to the seller and or co-seller if title is joined by AND.
cells.H: Transfer of ownership cannot be completed until all required registered owner's signed

cells.C: If the name is incorrect for the purchaser on "Seller must enter purchaser's name"
cells.H: The individual that is taking ownership of the vehicle, their name must be printed on the "seller must enter purchaser's line"
cells.I: Bring back title and bill of sale or bring in seller and the clerk can complete the transaction.

cells.C: The purchaser is under 18 years of age
cells.D: They need someone that is 18 years and older to be co-purchaser.

cells.C: The odometer is less than what was previously recorded on the title
cells.I: Depending on the year of the vehicle, we can exempt the mileage or record as NOT ACTUAL.

cells.C: You are not the individual that is transferring title
cells.D: We need a power of attorney document signed by the individual who's name will be on the title.
cells.H: Provides legal authorization for someone else to act on owner's behalf
cells.I: Have POA docusigned or original signature

cells.C: Customer wants to transfer title into a business name
cells.D: Provide Sunbiz document showing that business in registered with the department of state (active)
cells.H: We need to verify the registered agents of the business before the title can be transferred to the business name
cells.I: Have customer provide the Sunbiz document or have clerk print through Sunbiz website.

cells.B: Are you putting a vehicle into the name of a trust?
cells.C: Do you have the certification of trust or the trust agreement?
cells.D: Bring the certificate of trust or trust agreement
cells.H: Provide legal authorization & needs to be submitted with title work that gets sent to the state.
cells.I: If 1 trustee: individual can be present, multiple trustees: all come in, or have POA for the trustees that are not present.

cells.C: Is there 1 trustee or multiple trustees?

cells.B: Do you have the original title or a photocopy?
cells.D: We will not be able to serve them. They will need to bring the original title to our office with them.
cells.H: State of Florida requires the original title, not a photocopy

cells.B: What is the issue date of the title?

cells.C: If the title issue date does not match
cells.D: Provide the current issue date and direct customer to contact seller for original title or have owner provide duplicate

cells.B: If there are co-owners on the title, are the registered owners joined by AND or by OR on the title?
cells.C: If it is joined by AND
cells.D: Both registered owners need to sign the duplicate title form before we can perform the duplicate title transaction.
cells.H: FLHSMV requires both parties to sign before title can be issued
cells.I: Have both parties sign, or have power of attorney for the other individual.

cells.C: If it is joined by OR
cells.D: Only one registered owner needs to sign the duplicate title form before title issuance. If one of the owners is at the office, we can proceed with the transaction.
cells.H: FLHSMV requires at least one signature before title can be issued

cells.B: What is the model year of the vehicle?
cells.D: Provide actual mileage of the vehicle. If they don't have it, they MUST get it before we can do this transaction.
